method: These are supplemental exact checks, not an additional claim of full-prose reading. Japanese was independently read in full earlier by the lead; the ending was rechecked when Korean review exposed the same completion-versus-permission shift. Spanish 01–06 were independently read in full earlier by the lead; align the one remaining office reference with accepted terminology. Focused checks also clarify noncombat versus nonmilitary aid, responsibility for measures actually implemented after abstention, and concrete named management offices. Full independent reading remains in the per-language reports; these are source-based editorial corrections, not rules for real conflicts.

中文是设立一个具体‘管理处/管理所’，并未在此直接声称另建一套完整政府。德语Verwaltung虽也可指一个行政机关，不必一概判错，但未限定的eine Verwaltung容易被读作整套行政统治安排；用Verwaltungsstelle更明确地保持故事可见的具体行动，不取消其对人行使控制的后续判断。 邻段要先记具体行为再讨论定性，故本句尤其适宜具体化。
